maddeler.e:
نتهالك (form VI)
# نَتَهَالَكُ (natahālaku) /na.ta.haː.la.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# نَتَهَالَكَ (natahālaka) /na.ta.haː.la.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
# نَتَهَالَكْ (natahālak) /na.ta.haː.lak/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَهَالَكَ (tahālaka)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
